titulo: Me writing the thank-you by hand
caption:
Me writing the thank-you by hand

People guess a handwritten note will feel awkward to get. Most who get one say it meant more than they expected.

For the friend who still sends thank-you notes.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, facing a sheet of paper that appears on the right. It leans in with narrowed eyes while bubbles say dear Sam, then thanks for the book. then love, me. Its eyes go happy with a small pulse. The text stays: me writing the thank-you by hand. The last card: Choose friction.
